newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT -- Oil issues gain, Cemig off.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT -- Oil issues gain, Cemig off.

text.p: Year-end "window dressing" of stock portfolios Thursday lifted American Depositary Receipts of large-captialization, global petroleum companies in an otherwise quiet post-Christmas market, traders said.

They also reported the "pink sheet"-traded preferred shares of Cemig were off 7/8 to 32-3/4 after Brazil's Minas Gerais state suspended the sale of a 33 percent stake in the company after federal officials decided not to extend the deadline for the state's repayment of a loan.
Traders said Cemig's common shares, which fell sharply on Latin American bourses, are not listed in the United States.

As for the oil issues, a trader said: "These stocks are already widely-owned in the United States, so the traders are pushing them higher since it is the end of the year," a trader said, who added the closure of many overseas bourses shifted demand to the companies' American-listed stocks.
